meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

copy.tagline: 简化药物研发中的分子分析工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做药物研发,常需要用代码处理化学数据。
copy.tagline_en: Simplify molecular analysis in drug research and development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in drug discovery and want a friendlier way to process molecular data.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，做药物发现相关分子操作时，Claude会调用datamol库：解析SMILES、标准化结构、计算描述符/指纹等，并返回RDKit原生分子对象。
howto.when: 当用户要求做药物发现类的分子常规分析时，例如解析SMILES、计算描述符或聚类分子，本技能会介入处理。

say.text: 请帮我把这些SMILES标准化，并算出每个分子的描述符。
say.note: 会返回标准化后的SMILES和每个分子的描述符数值。

say.text: 请用指纹算一下这几个分子两两间的Tanimoto相似度。
say.note: 会生成指纹并返回两两之间的Tanimoto距离/相似度。

say.text: 请为这个分子生成3D构象，然后保存成SDF文件。
say.note: 会生成多个3D构象（UFF能量最小化）并写为SDF文件。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, for drug discovery molecule tasks Claude will call the datamol library: parse SMILES, standardize structures, compute descriptors/fingerprints, and return native RDKit Mol objects.
howto.when_en: When routine drug-discovery analysis of molecules is requested (e.g., parsing SMILES, computing descriptors, clustering compounds), this skill takes over.

say_en.text: Please standardize these SMILES and compute descriptors for each molecule.
say_en.note: Returns standardized SMILES and descriptor values per molecule.

say_en.text: Compare pairwise Tanimoto similarity of these molecules with fingerprints.
say_en.note: Builds fingerprints and returns Tanimoto distance/similarity.

say_en.text: Generate 3D conformers for this molecule and save them as an SDF file.
say_en.note: Generates and UFF-minimizes conformers, writes an SDF file.
